subject: Temporary vendor authorization / no-PO waiver request — Pathway Labs pilot
messages:
From: Kelsey Tran <kelsey.tran@pathway.ai>
To: markus.klein@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-23T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: temporary no-PO onboarding for pilot - Pathway Labs

Hi Markus,

Hope you’re well — I’m Kelsey on the vendor ops side at Pathway Labs. We’re excited to run a 3-month integration pilot with Redwood Inference starting next week. Pathway is an early-stage company and our procurement process doesn’t issue formal POs on short timelines for pilots.

Pilot summary:
- Scope: integration + usage testing for two workloads
- Estimated spend: $12,500 over ~60 days
- Invoicing cadence requested: one invoice at the end of month

Can Redwood make a one-time, temporary exception to accept invoices without a PO for this initial pilot? If needed we can sign a short commercial agreement or add specific invoice language.

I’ve attached our vendor intake form and a completed W‑9. Happy to provide any additional docs (company registration, proof of insurance) — just tell me what you need.

Next steps I’m hoping for: quick procurement confirmation + AP routing instructions so we can submit our invoice.

Thanks,
Kelsey Tran
Vendor Operations
Pathway Labs
Attachments: vendor-intake-form.pdf, w9.pdf
From: markus.klein@redwood.com
To: Kelsey Tran <kelsey.tran@pathway.ai>
Cc: priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-23T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary no-PO onboarding for pilot - Pathway Labs

Kelsey — thanks for the note and the attachments. Welcome to Redwood.

Quick questions so Procurement and Finance can assess the request:
- Can you confirm legal entity name and country of incorporation?
- Proposed payment terms (Net 30/Net 45?) and invoice recipient
- Any contract you’d like us to sign for a short pilot (we can do an SOW or a short services addendum)

High-level policy: we do allow short-term no‑PO invoicing for pilots under certain thresholds, but it requires documented intake, finance approval, and AP routing to invoices@redwood.com with the phrase "Pilot — Pathway Labs" on the invoice. I’m looping Priya from Procurement to complete the intake checklist.

If Procurement and Finance sign off, I can approve a temporary waiver up to $25k for up to 90 days. Otherwise we’ll need a PO before payment.

— Markus
Head of Partnerships (acting)
Redwood Inference

Thanks for looping me in, Markus. Hi Kelsey — I reviewed the form you sent and attached a filled intake sheet for our records (vendor-intake-form-filled.xlsx).

Procurement checklist status (summary):
- Vendor legal name: Pathway Labs, Inc. (confirmed)
- W‑9 received: yes
- Proof of commercial general liability: pending (please send if available)
- Bank wiring instructions: provided on intake form
- Product/service description: integration pilot (matches internal SOW)

Based on the intake, this is a standard small-pilot case and meets our low-risk criteria (no sensitive data access, vendor not handling customer PII). Recommended next step: Finance sign-off on temporary no‑PO lane, and AP instructions sent to vendor.

I’ve also linked our internal procurement playbook — it outlines the limited-waiver process and required invoice language: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ProcurePlaybook_sample

If legal wants to review a short addendum we can loop them — otherwise Procurement is fine to proceed to Finance for the waiver.

Attachments: vendor-intake-form-filled.xlsx

— Priya Natarajan
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
From: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
To: markus.klein@redwood.com, priya_natarajan@redwood.com, Kelsey Tran <kelsey.tran@pathway.ai>
Date: 2027-08-24T11:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary no-PO onboarding for pilot - Pathway Labs

Hi all — Finance review complete. Thanks for the thorough intake, Priya.

Decision: Finance approves a temporary no-PO authorization for Pathway Labs under the following conditions:
1) Maximum exposure limited to $15,000 total for the pilot period. Any amount above $15k requires a PO or explicit finance escalation.
2) Waiver duration: 60 days from invoice date (we can extend once with documented justification).
3) Invoices must be sent to invoices@redwood.com, include the phrase "Pilot - Pathway Labs" in the invoice header, and reference deal_id DL-2027-044.
4) Payment terms: Net 30.
5) Pathway must provide proof of commercial liability insurance (COI) or a written confirmation that none is required for this scope.

I attached a short temporary waiver template for records (temp-waiver-sample.pdf). If Pathway signs a short addendum or DocuSign, please share the link so we can archive it.

Markus — please confirm if you’re comfortable with those limits. Kelsey — if that works, Pathway can submit Invoice #001 and we’ll route it for payment under the waiver.

— Naomi Feldman
Finance Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: temp-waiver-sample.pdf
From: Kelsey Tran <kelsey.tran@pathway.ai>
To: markus.klein@redwood.com, priya_natarajan@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-24T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary no-PO onboarding for pilot - Pathway Labs

Thanks Naomi — that is perfect and clear. Pathway accepts the $15k / 60-day temporary waiver conditions. We will send COI by end of week (we have a current policy).

Attached is Invoice #001 for the first month of the pilot (Pathway_Invoice_001.pdf). Invoice total is $10,875. It includes the phrase "Pilot - Pathway Labs" in the header and references DL-2027-044. Please confirm receipt and that AP has the correct routing.

Appreciate the quick turnaround from your team. Looking forward to getting the pilot underway.

Best,
Kelsey
Vendor Operations
Pathway Labs
Attachments: Pathway_Invoice_001.pdf
